captions.detailed: A flat, circular washer with a central round hole. The outer edge has a subtly faceted cylindrical surface, while the top and bottom faces are completely flat. It is thin, with its diameter being roughly five times its thickness.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric flat washer in OpenSCAD. Provide parameters to adjust the outer diameter, inner bolt diameter, and thickness, ensuring the cylindrical facets adjust dynamically based on a resolution parameter.
captions.factory: The washer module is constructed using a difference() boolean operation. A outer cylinder is created with a height equal to the washer thickness (wtk) and a radius based on the calculated washer radius (wrd). From this, a smaller central cylinder with the bolt radius (brd) is subtracted to form the inner hole. The facet count ($fn) is dynamically calculated using a custom function fn4r() to maintain smooth circular geometry.
